review: Independent source review of connected Macro Studio recording
resolved_finding: Settings interruption now rejects while a connected recording is active, before cancellation or router/settings side effects; a focused regression verifies recording state/count, committed clip, packet history, and held input are unchanged, then verifies interruption succeeds after explicit local discard.
notes: Connected recording belongs to one client and records only that client accepted logical actions. Capacity is checked before delivery; failed delivery is not appended. Partial text delivery does not falsely record a complete Text action.

Owner stop commits only after validation; empty or invalid recording preserves the prior clip and records an error. Disconnect, revocation, and global cancel paths discard the temporary candidate without replacing the committed clip.
The final source adds retryable claim retention when a routed release fails, so failed Tap-up cleanup can be retried.
recording_client remains inspectable protocol attribution metadata, not a secret or credential; user-facing labels do not display the numeric client ID.
Source review only; no native acceptance claim. ReleaseAll is treated by the implementation as an explicit global cancel/release action.
producer_status: Final producer235859 passed fmt, strict Clippy, 171 workspace tests, and x64/i686 builds.
